svg.title: Thin Backslash
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 4 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Thin backslash now lives on the default calt editor path.
细反斜杠已经迁到默认 calt 编辑器路径。

g.text: This is handled by calt, so ordinary editor ligature toggles can reach it.
它由 calt 处理，普通编辑器的连写开关也能覆盖。
This changes the backslash outline, not its color or opacity.
它只改变反斜杠轮廓，不改变颜色或透明度。
